title: Tinsukia Open 2026
description: The club's flagship open tournament, welcoming players from across Assam and the Northeast. Three days of competitive tennis across multiple categories, showcasing the best talent in the region.

title: TTC Club Championship 2025
description: The annual club championship — the most anticipated event in the TTC calendar. Open to all club members, this tournament determines the club champion in each category for the year.

title: TTC Junior Championship 2026
description: A dedicated tournament for junior players under 18. Designed to give young competitors match experience in a structured tournament environment, building confidence and competitive readiness.

title: TTC Women's Championship 2026
description: Celebrating women's tennis at TTC. This championship provides a competitive platform exclusively for women players of all levels, promoting participation and development in women's tennis across the region.

title: Summer Coaching Camp 2026
description: A 10-day intensive coaching camp for juniors and beginners. Covering fundamentals, stroke technique, footwork, match play, and fitness — all guided by the club's coaching team.

title: Tinsukia Open 2027
description: The second edition of the Tinsukia Open. Building on the success of 2026, this tournament will feature expanded categories and welcome even more players from across the Northeast.

title: Winter Tennis Camp 2026
description: An intensive winter camp for players looking to improve during the off-season. Focus on technical refinement, tactical development and competitive preparation for the new year.
